steps: From Kaneshie Market, head north on Kaneshie-Odorkor Highway
Avoid the underpass near the lorry station, known flood point
Turn right onto First Light Rd
Kaneshie Community Centre is 400m ahead on the left
From Circle roundabout, take the overpass, do not use the tunnel
Head toward Kwame Nkrumah Circle interchange
Assembly Hall entrance is on the eastern side
From Alajo Main Rd, move away from the Odaw river bank
Head east toward the Presbyterian church
School compound is behind the church, follow the marshals
From Oxford St, head south toward Barnes Rd
Stadium gates open for shelter on the north entrance
